properties.description: Implements requirement B of the proof build order. An inference step carries confirmed_by (who), confirmed_how (person/checker/unconfirmed) and confirmed_at (when). get_node on a conclusion computes proof_status by walking the derivation chain: proven means every step is confirmed, shown means the chain holds but has unconfirmed steps, unproven means no derivation holds. A CONTRADICTS edge with opposing alignment sets the target's truth to fails, which propagates through downstream inference chains — the counterexample half of the proof requirement.
properties.name: Each inference step records who confirmed it (person/checker/unconfirmed), get_node returns proof_status (proven/shown/unproven) on conclusions, and a CONTRADICTS edge makes truth fail
